description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git rebase' commands, specifically the '--fork-point' option. It sets up test repositories, executes various rebase scenarios, and checks the outcomes to ensure correct behavior.

methods.name: do_test_rebase
methods.description: Performs a rebase operation with specified parameters and checks the output against expected results.

methods.name: test_rebase
